subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Construir o sentido global de textos orais, relacionando suas partes, o assunto principal e informações relevantes.

components.description_pt: Identificar o tema principal de texto oral conectando suas partes-chave
components.description_en: Identify the main topic of an oral text by connecting its key parts
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main topic and key details in an informational text

components.description_pt: Extrair informações relevantes de texto oral para construir seu significado geral
components.description_en: Extract relevant information from an oral text to construct its overall meaning
components.cc_component_description: Gather relevant information from multiple sources to investigate a topic

components.description_pt: Conectar diferentes seções de texto oral para construir compreensão unificada de seu conteúdo
components.description_en: Connect different sections of an oral text to build a unified understanding of its content
components.cc_component_description: Explain how major sections of a primary source work together to build the whole text

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret informational texts in language arts (with prompting and support) by
* Identifying main topic and key details
* Asking and answering questions about descriptions of familiar attributes and characteristics
* Identifying word choices in relation to topic content area
Conduct short as well as more sustained research projects based on focused questions, demonstrating understanding of the subject under investigation.
Analyze in detail how a complex primary source is structured, including how key sentences, paragraphs, and larger portions of the text contribute to the whole.
